title: Rule effect input (v0.6, D73, D89)
description: Input of the rule-effect vectors: the one function of status and effect of a rule of any repository (contract/rules). Five ops: the status and effect of a rule (effect), what a matched rule does to one request (request), what a repository does (repository), the state of a repository with the settings overlay (switch), the scope check of a write of the agent API (agent_write).

repositoryId.description: crs (OWASP CRS, built into the binary), crowdsec (CrowdSec Hub virtual patches), local (the operator's rules.d).

state.description: State of a repository. off: no rules, nothing fetched. detect: rules match and are logged, never block. block.

mode.description: D89: there is no protection mode to set. observe is the dry run of the test profile, in which nothing blocks; autoblock every other gateway.

rule.description: One rule of one repository at one moment.

origin.description: release: ships with the image. update: received while the gateway runs. operator: the operator's own file.

settling_until.description: Unix second an update has settled (absent: none).

site_mode.description: observe: the website is set to observe.

excepted.description: An unblock excepts this rule's source for this client.

overlay.description: The value in the settings overlay (absent: none).

overlay_by.description: Who set the overlay value (absent: dashboard).

reset.description: Drop the overlay value: schild.yaml counts again.

scope.description: Scope of a token that authenticated.
